name: @emsenn/decision-topology
description: Decision as a morphism: read a meme-topology section, draw a linear budget, emit a typed action or a typed abstention. Trading, voting, and curation are specializations.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/package-boundary/copy-dmts-to-dts.mjs dist
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ".tmp/test-dist/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run audit:boundary
